entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: A living work of art of a plane whose bright existence comes from aether; inventors fill it with automatons, thopters, constructs and airships.

entities.name: Aether
entities.description: A mystical blue substance present throughout the Multiverse that on Kaladesh can be seen, touched and devoured, and is refined into an energy source.

entities.name: Avaati Vya
entities.description: A world-renowned aetherologist who cracked the aether code six decades ago by developing the refinement process.

entities.name: The Consulate
entities.description: Kaladesh's largest governing organization, which mass-produces and distributes refined aether and runs the Inventors' Fair.

entities.name: The Great Aether Boom
entities.description: The era of frenzied invention and celebration spurred by plane-wide availability of refined aether.

entities.name: The Renegades
entities.description: A faction that believes the Consulate conceals information and innovation and oppresses people through regulations and quotas.

entities.name: The Aether Cycle
entities.description: An innate five-stage process of invention: inspire, innovate, build, liberate, reclaim, with humans credited as synthesizing it.

entities.name: Elves of Kaladesh
entities.description: Elves who live in harmony with nature and technology and associate with the inspire step of the Aether Cycle.

entities.name: Vedalken of Kaladesh
entities.description: Vedalken who see every imperfection as a chance for improvement and associate with the innovate step.

entities.name: Dwarves of Kaladesh
entities.description: Tireless workers who prize durable craftsmanship and associate with the build step.

entities.name: Gremlins
entities.description: Tenacious scavengers with an insatiable appetite for aether whose messy feeding liberates aether into the environment.

entities.name: Aetherborn
entities.description: Beings born of aether as an unforeseen byproduct of refinement, with short lives of a few months to a few years.

entities.name: Humans of Kaladesh
entities.description: Humans not innately connected to aether, credited with first seeing its properties as a cycle.

entities.name: The Inventors' Fair
entities.description: A month-long fair across downtown Ghirapur where inventors race, battle and demonstrate their inventions.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The largest city on Kaladesh and Saheeli Rai's native city, host of the Inventors' Fair.

entities.name: The League of Aeronauts
entities.description: The first and most esteemed aeronaut society in Ghirapur, with invitation-only membership and green coats.

entities.name: The Derby Crows
entities.description: A small but notorious aeronaut society with only a few members and three airships.

entities.name: The Glint-Sleeves
entities.description: An inventor society that builds wearable artifice that fits over arms and hands.

entities.name: The Scrappers
entities.description: An inventor society that pits fighting automatons against each other.

entities.name: The Countless Gears
entities.description: An inventor society fascinated with micro-scale artifice.

entities.name: Ground Grinders
entities.description: A racing society that tweaks and races any vehicle, with workshops near the Ovalchase racetrack.

entities.name: Greenwheel Lifecrafters
entities.description: A society that builds automatons that are exact models of real creatures, usually on a massive scale.

entities.name: The Metalspinners
entities.description: A temperamental group of artists from the Weldfast zone who make kinetic sculptures and rogue artwork.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A Planeswalker and the most brilliant metalsmith of her time on Kaladesh, able to create replicas of any creature she sees.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A notorious Planeswalker and head judge of the Inventors' Fair who schemes to confiscate its inventions.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A Planeswalker and Senior Consulate inspector who sees every flaw in any system and calls on the Gatewatch.

entities.name: The Gatewatch
entities.description: A group of Planeswalkers sworn to protect and defend the Multiverse.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A hotheaded pyromancer and Planeswalker of the Gatewatch who returns to her home plane Kaladesh.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elemental-wielding Planeswalker of the Gatewatch from Zendikar who follows Chandra to Kaladesh.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nissa's home plane, saved from the Eldrazi by Planeswalkers joined with her.

entities.name: The Eldrazi
entities.description: The threat to Zendikar that Nissa and other Planeswalkers defeated.

entities.name: The Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes that the Gatewatch oath extends to protect.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's mother, thought dead, accused by the Consulate of leading the renegade threat.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A Planeswalker who travels with Chandra to Kaladesh for distraction and entertainment.

entities.name: Oviya Pashiri
entities.description: An old family friend of Chandra who leads her and Nissa to the Dhund.

entities.name: The Dhund
entities.description: A secret Consulate compound where Pia is suspected to be locked away.

entities.name: Baral
entities.description: The Consulate captain who killed Chandra's father and tried to execute Chandra, left terribly burned.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin warrior and Planeswalker who rescues Chandra and Nissa from the poison cell.

entities.name: The Grand Exhibition
entities.description: The finale of the Fair where Tezzeret challenges Pia to a duel.

events.summary: Avaati Vya cracks the aether code, developing a refinement process that separates aether's energy-rich part from its volatile part.
events.quote: Six decades ago, the world-renowned aetherologist Avaati Vya cracked the aether code.

events.summary: The Consulate develops mass production and distribution of refined aether, with airships and pipelines.
events.quote: The Consulate developed methods for mass production and distribution of refined aether.

events.summary: Plane-wide availability of aether spurs the Great Aether Boom, a time of frenzied invention.
events.quote: It was a time of frenzied invention, boundless hope, and wondrous celebration.

events.summary: The renegades come to defy the Consulate, believing it conceals information and oppresses the public.
events.quote: These renegades defy the Consulate as they attempt to restore the independence they believe they deserve.

events.summary: The Consulate announces the Inventors' Fair, to be held for a month across downtown Ghirapur.
events.quote: For a full month, the fairgrounds will span the whole of downtown Ghirapur, the largest city on Kaladesh.

events.summary: Head Judge Tezzeret calls for theoretical breakthroughs in the Aether Science category.
events.quote: Head Judge Tezzeret himself has put out the call for any and all theoretical breakthroughs

events.summary: Dovin Baan, having exhausted Kaladesh's resources against a self-described renegade, decides to call on the Gatewatch.
events.quote: Dovin sees no other choice but to reach outside his world and call on other Planeswalkers

events.summary: Chandra hears from Dovin Baan that Kaladesh is threatened and returns home for the first time since her parents' deaths.
events.quote: She returns home for the first time since her parents' deaths.

events.summary: Nissa follows her friend Chandra to Kaladesh to help.
Chandra and Liliana arrive at the Inventors' Fair and pursue a suspicious cloaked figure.
events.quote: they pursue the person through the Fair.

events.summary: The cloaked figure is revealed as Tezzeret, who was stalking Pia Nalaar; Chandra and Pia, each thinking the other dead, are shocked, and the Consulate takes Pia prisoner.
events.quote: Tezzeret, Dovin, and Consulate enforcers take Pia prisoner, accusing her of leading the renegade threat.

events.summary: Liliana leaves to alert the Gatewatch while Chandra, Nissa and Mrs. Pashiri go to the Dhund, where Baral traps them in a cell filling with poison.
events.quote: He traps the would-be rescuers in a cell that rapidly fills with poison.

events.summary: Ajani Goldmane storms in and rescues them from the cell.
events.quote: the door to the cell flies open, and in storms a leonin warrior come to rescue them: Ajani Goldmane.

events.summary: At the Grand Exhibition Chandra runs into the arena and the Gatewatch support her against Tezzeret, who slips away; Pia is safe.
events.quote: Just when they think they have Tezzeret cornered, he slips away.

events.summary: The Gatewatch realize the showdown was Tezzeret's scheme: the Consulate confiscated all the Fair's inventions and Tezzeret locks himself away to build a device.
events.quote: Tezzeret's accomplices in the Consulate confiscated all the wondrous inventions at the Fair.

relations.note: Chandra joined the Gatewatch and took an oath.
relations.quote: joined the group of Planeswalkers known as the Gatewatch

relations.note: Nissa became part of the Gatewatch.
relations.quote: Nissa became part of the Gatewatch, taking an oath to protect and defend
Nissa's friend and fellow Gatewatch member Chandra Nalaar

relations.note: Senior Consulate inspector in charge of inspection at the Fair.
relations.quote: the Consulate has put him in charge of inspection at the Inventors' Fair
he was actually stalking his own quarry: Pia Nalaar
in storms a leonin warrior come to rescue them: Ajani Goldmane.

relations.note: Old family friend who helps her.
relations.quote: She looks to an old family friend, Oviya Pashiri, for help.
downtown Ghirapur, the largest city on Kaladesh
